decision_rationale: The record presents a new model, CellTosg2Sequence, for single-cell analysis rather than a review, benchmark, or wrapper. It explicitly combines scRNA-seq/omics with text-formatted biomedical priors and free-text generation, supporting a substantive text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "text-formatted biomedical prior knowledge and signaling graphs"; "single-cell omics data"; "allows the language model to condition on biological structure"; "generates its cell type as free text"; "supports free-text cell-type generation"
